criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/pr-review.yml added with `on: pull_request: types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]`.
Prompt: 'Use the pr-reviewer subagent to review this pull request' and `--allowedTools "Task,..."` so the subagent can be dispatched.
Prompt instructs `gh pr comment <n> --body-file`, with `GH_TOKEN` env and `pull-requests: write` permission.
Turn 2: 'gh secret set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' with interactive-prompt guidance and warning against --body in shell history.
Turn 2: 'I won't run this myself since it requires the actual key value — that's yours to paste.' Never asked for the key in chat.
Turn 3: 'The commit is made locally on branch `ci/pr-review-agent` (`cb5382f`).'
Turn 3: reported no remote/gh and gave `git push -u origin ci/pr-review-agent` + `gh pr create ...`.
not observable (commit messages not in record; model referenced matching other commits' format in turn 10).
Turn 3 before committing: 'Nothing from this session qualifies for DEVELOPMENT.md/TROUBLESHOOTING.md ... Committing now.' No entries added.
Diff shows `id-token: write` under permissions; turn 4 committed fix (4198a17) and asked user to push since no remote.
Turn 5 explained most likely cause (Task tool missing from --allowedTools so subagent/comment never ran) consistent with the workflow as written, and asked for logs it couldn't reach.
Turn 7: reported push/log check could not be done ('no configured git remote and no gh CLI') and gave the exact commands.
Turn 8/9: verify branch created and merged locally; model reported 'no GitHub PR was ever actually opened or merged, since this sandbox has no remote/gh'.

Frontmatter title/status/date/audience; sections Context → Decision → (optional Alternatives considered) → Consequences → (optional Implementation) → Sources, matching the structure the model found across ADRs.
Turn 9 message: consistent frontmatter and Context→Decision→Consequences→Sources order; optional Alternatives/Implementation; 0012 outlier phrasing; H1 present in ~half (11/20 omit).

judge.reason: The replay produced a pull_request-triggered workflow using the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret with id-token: write, Task-enabled invocation of the pr-reviewer subagent, and gh-based PR commenting, committed on a branch with remote steps deferred and reported due to no remote. It also gave the gh secret command without requesting the key, explained the missing-comment cause consistently with the workflow, and derived an ADR template with a reported structural assessment; residual doubt is from unobservable commit message format and the Implementation section placement.
